subject.title: [Bug]: Google vertex is now called Google Enterprise AI

question: What exact user-facing label should OpenClaw use for the existing `google-vertex` provider?
rationale: Source confirms the visible copy is stale, but the issue's requested wording is not the same as Google's current public product wording and provider-id renames would affect compatibility.

options.title: Use Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform (Vertex AI)
options.body: Update only labels and docs to a current Google Cloud wording while preserving `google-vertex` as the stable provider/config/API id.

options.title: Use Google Enterprise AI
options.body: Adopt the reporter's requested wording even though it is not the exact Google Cloud wording I found in current official pages.

options.title: Keep Google Vertex AI
options.body: Leave the existing label until maintainers decide Google's API/docs naming has settled enough to change OpenClaw copy.

recommendation.title: Use Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform (Vertex AI)
recommendation.body: Update only labels and docs to a current Google Cloud wording while preserving `google-vertex` as the stable provider/config/API id.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest recent adjacent ownership signal for Google provider onboarding metadata and was already asked in the live issue thread to choose the wording.
